published_output_convention: Section 7.1: boxes within each label are stably sorted by x1; implemented by the within-class x-order check.

user_proposed_reward_interpretation.count_agreement: binary exact total count equality, replacing the old min/max draft
user_proposed_reward_interpretation.threshold_f1_and_matched_iou: continuous values multiplied by published weights
user_proposed_reward_interpretation.oversized_unmatched_penalty: raw count, one -.07 penalty per qualifying box, no division by prediction count
user_proposed_reward_interpretation.duplicate_penalty: raw count, one -.03 penalty per later duplicate prediction, no division by prediction count

rex_sourced_rules.coordinate_geometry: Directly call official BoxIoURewardFunction.calculate_iou via the adaptation helper.
rex_sourced_rules.box_extraction: Directly call official BoxIoURewardFunction.parse_detection_output after strict validation; convert its q/1000 coordinates to the SFT q/999 convention.
rex_sourced_rules.valid_empty_cases: Follow Rex box reward: empty GT plus empty prediction = 1; only one side empty = 0. This fallback is based on the user's instruction to reuse overlapping Rex behavior, not a published GroundingPI empty-GT equation.

user_experiment_constraints.tuner: existing SFT LoRA rank 16, alpha 32 and its 1000 coordinate rows

single_gpu_execution.note: Chunk size controls memory only; all 256 rewards are collected before advantage normalization and one optimizer update. The paper uses 256 GPUs, accumulation 1, ZeRO-2.

unpublished_details_pending_confirmation.strict_reward_matching: Existing adaptation uses class-aware maximum-cardinality matching; exact matching/tie-breaking not published.
unpublished_details_pending_confirmation.strict_reward_matched_iou: Existing adaptation averages matches at IoU >= 0.5; exact averaging convention not published.
unpublished_details_pending_confirmation.strict_reward_duplicates: Draft now counts later same-class predictions having IoU >= 0.9 with an earlier prediction. Per-box counting follows the user proposal; the .9 threshold and exact duplicate definition are not published or confirmed.
unpublished_details_pending_confirmation.strict_reward_oversize: Draft now counts boxes with area > 0.8 and no same-class GT at IoU >= 0.5. Per-box unmatched-only counting follows the user proposal; area/support thresholds are not published or confirmed.
unpublished_details_pending_confirmation.strict_reward_format: Existing adaptation gives 0 to both rewards on globally invalid Rex format; paper specifies a strict format component but not full parser/error gating.
unpublished_details_pending_confirmation.rollout_sampling_and_length: Current experimental values temperature=1, top_p=1, top_k=0, completion=1024, max_length=4096; no matching RL table values located.
unpublished_details_pending_confirmation.training_duration: Current experiment has one epoch over the fixed 10000-image subset; RL epoch/step budget not stated in Table 11. 10000 is not divisible by 32, so treatment of the final 16 prompts also needs confirmation.
